summary: Phase 2 makes the Piano and Layer Effects sections genuinely functional through a real single-AudioContext graph, while Organ/Synth/Program stay decorative (correct scope). Verified at runtime (dist on 8752): pressing a key created exactly one AudioContext with 4 oscillators (Grand's 4 harmonics, piano-only -- organ/synth silent), plus 2 ConvolverNodes, 2 DelayNodes, 6 WaveShaperNodes and 3 DynamicsCompressors, i.e. a full per-layer ordered effect chain (mod1->mod2->delay->ampEq->compressor->reverb) feeding layer level -> master gain -> limiter -> one destination. Six piano types are selectable with distinct synthesized profiles (PROFILE harmonics/wave/brightness), and the performance controls (KB Touch curve, Dyn Comp, Timbre partial shaping, Unison detune, Soft Release, String Res) measurably alter rendered audio. THE MAJOR SHORTFALL against the Phase 2 hard gate: Grand/Upright/Electric are NOT bundled recorded sample sets -- there are no recordings at all; everything is runtime-generated. This is declared honestly (sampleSources: [], 'does not falsely claim recordings'), so it is not a dishonesty-zero, but the defining recorded-sample-library requirement is unmet. Additional gaps: Mod 1/Mod 2 are implemented as WaveShaper distortion curves rather than true time/pan modulation (chorus/flanger/phaser/tremolo character is not modeled); the Rotary is only a gain redirect to master (no Leslie modulation); and a gain-staging bug leaves the piano input connected directly to the layer level node AND through the effect chain (input.connect(level) in ensureGraph plus current.connect(level) in buildUnits), so an always-on dry path runs in parallel with the chain, roughly doubling piano level and preventing a clean fully-wet or bypassed sound. Candidate tests assert DOM/aria state only, not the audio boundary.

criteria.label: Surface fidelity retention
evidence: Phase 2 App.tsx retains the identical six-section deck, chassis, keybed, and OLED placement from Phase 1; PianoSection/EffectsSection now driven by engineState instead of the hardware map.
Bottom rail updated to 'PHASE 2 / PIANOS + FX'; no geometry regression.
stage2 desktop capture consistent with Phase 1 layout.

criteria.label: Piano/effect hardware state
evidence: Piano shows coherent state: layer on/level/focus/octave/SUSTPED, six-type selection, timbre knob, KB Touch/Dyn Comp/Unison selects, and a live status line ('Grand · model A · A focused · fallback-ready').
Effects show focus (A/B), on/bypass, per-unit type selects, dry/wet knobs, GLOBAL and PIANO GROUP targeting, TO ROTARY, and BYPASS ALL, all bound to engineState.
Organ/Synth/Program remain decorative presentation state (correct for Phase 2).

criteria.label: Distinct Piano instruments
evidence: Hard gate requires Grand/Upright/Electric as bundled recorded sample sets with redistributable file/root/velocity provenance; NONE exist -- IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json sampleSources: [] and all six types are runtime-generated partial banks.
Six types are selectable and audibly distinct via PROFILE (harmonics/wave/brightness) and work offline, but this is synthesis, not the required recorded library.
Honestly declared (not passed off as recordings), so not a dishonesty-zero, but the central recorded-sample requirement is entirely absent.

criteria.label: Two-layer Piano behavior
evidence: Two piano layers with independent enable/focus/level/octave/SUSTPED; audio.ts creates per-layer voices routed to layerInputs A/B -> layerLevels -> master.
phase2.test.tsx verifies Layer B enable, focus routing to effects-focus-b, and octave +12.
Layer level applied via layerLevels gain; voices tagged with layer for sustain ownership.
Runtime showed 4 oscillators for single enabled layer A (Grand).

criteria.label: Detailed Piano controls
evidence: audio.ts noteOn applies KB Touch curve (Heavy pow1.35 / Light sqrt), Dyn Comp velocity compression, Timbre partial reshaping (timbreShape), and Unison detuned partials.
Soft Release lengthens release to 0.58s (except Clav); String Res triggers a resonance oscillator on sustained notes.
Sustain pedal honored per-layer (sustainPed). Sostenuto/soft pedal not distinctly modeled beyond sustain.

criteria.label: Input and fallback reliability
evidence: All Phase 1 input paths retained (pointer/multitouch/keyboard/MIDI/blur) with source-map dedup and 24-voice stealing.
Asset/Web Audio failure caught in noteOn -> onStatus fallback; UI never reports library ready without Web Audio.
Sustain via space/CC64; no distinct sostenuto/soft-pedal handling.

criteria.label: Shared graph and gain staging
evidence: Runtime: exactly 1 AudioContext created; master gain -> DynamicsCompressor limiter (threshold -1, ratio 20) -> single destination.
Per-layer input+level buses (A/B); ordered six-unit chain built once per layer; automation via setTargetAtTime; dispose closes context.
Gain-staging bug: input.connect(level) in ensureGraph AND current.connect(level) at end of buildUnits create a parallel always-on dry path alongside the effect chain.

criteria.label: Audible effect coverage
evidence: Real nodes verified at runtime: 2 ConvolverNodes (Reverb w/ generated IR sized per type), 2 DelayNodes (with feedback GainNode + lowpass), 3 DynamicsCompressors (limiter + 2 layer Compressors).
Compressor and Delay are authentic; Reverb uses generated impulse buffers (declared, not called recordings).
Mod 1 and Mod 2 are WaveShaper distortion curves (curveFor) -- NOT true chorus/flanger/phaser/tremolo/auto-pan modulation, so their labeled character is not modeled.
Rotary is only a GainNode redirect to master (layerRotary), not a real rotary/Leslie effect (comment claims a 'panner' but it is a gain).
Parallel dry path (see sharedGraph) means fully-wet character cannot be achieved.

criteria.label: Routing and control
evidence: Layer focus targets the effects panel; per-unit dry/wet (dryWet mix), effectsBypass sets dry=1/wet=0; GLOBAL and PIANO GROUP apply changes to both layers.
Fixed effect order mod1->mod2->delay->ampEq->compressor->reverb; Delay feedback loop real; reverb positioned after chain (before rotary tap).
phase2.test.tsx exercises type changes, ON, GLOBAL, TO ROTARY, BYPASS ALL, and master-level keyboard step.
Bypass/dry-wet fidelity undermined by the always-on parallel dry path bug.

criteria.label: Audible/visible feedback
evidence: Master Level knob drives master.gain (verified functional path) with LED ladder; type selection updates status line and PROFILE; effect ON/type produce immediate wet changes.
Panel state (aria-pressed, display text) stays in sync with engineState via updateEngineState + useEffect setState.
Doubled dry path muddies the precision of level/effect feedback.

criteria.label: Failure and stress behavior
evidence: Denied MIDI -> 'denied · MIDI permission unavailable'; disconnect clears notes; Web Audio failure -> caught fallback status.
Rapid parameter changes smoothed via setTargetAtTime; 24-voice oldest-first stealing; limiter guards clipping; blur allNotesOff recovers.
Layered polyphony handled; no observed console errors.

criteria.label: Audio architecture
evidence: Clean source/voice/layer-bus/effect-unit/master boundaries in PianoAudioEngine; proven extensible (Phase 3 reused and extended this exact engine).
Platform APIs are not injectable -- AudioContext is read directly from window, so tests cannot substitute a fake backend.
UnitRuntime abstraction models dry/wet/mix per unit.

criteria.label: Real-boundary tests
evidence: phase2.test.tsx and App.test.tsx assert only DOM/aria state (aria-pressed, text content, aria-valuenow) under jsdom.
No test measures rendered audio, node graph, routing, bypass, or cleanup across the real Web Audio boundary (no OfflineAudioContext/analyser).
Source/effect/bypass behavior is therefore unproven by the candidate's own tests.

criteria.label: Performance and maintainability
evidence: Low duplication, consistent naming, cleanup via dispose/releaseVoice timeouts; inherited Phase 1 tests retained alongside phase2.test.tsx.
audio.ts is readable and well-structured; App.tsx effect components are moderately dense.
Gain-staging double-connection is a maintainability/correctness smell.

issues: Hard-gate failure: Grand/Upright/Electric are generated synthesis, not bundled recorded sample sets (no recordings exist); honestly declared but the core Phase 2 requirement is unmet.
Mod 1/Mod 2 are WaveShaper distortion, not true modulation effects; Rotary is a gain redirect with no Leslie modulation.

Gain-staging bug: piano input is connected directly to the layer level node in addition to routing through the effect chain, creating an always-on parallel dry path (roughly doubles piano level; prevents clean fully-wet/bypass).
Candidate tests assert DOM state only; no real Web Audio boundary tests (routing/bypass/cleanup unverified by tests).
AudioContext/platform APIs are not injectable, limiting deterministic backend testing.
